title: Turn all radio switches on or off
summary: Enable or disable all network radio switches (Wi-Fi and WWAN) simultaneously. Useful for quickly entering airplane mode or restoring connectivity.

steps.explain: Turn all radio switches (Wi-Fi and WWAN) on or off. Replace <STATE> with 'on' to enable or 'off' to disable.
steps.expect: The command completes without error. All wireless connectivity changes immediately.

rollback.explain: To undo, set all radio switches back to their previous state.

placeholders.name: PREVIOUS_STATE
placeholders.description: The state radios were in before (on or off)

warnings: Turning all radios off will disconnect you from all wireless networks (Wi-Fi and cellular).
